report: H2 direct visual inspection - ASMBI manuscript
scope: Read-only inspection of the ASMBI manuscript PDF and all 25 page PNGs. Only this JSON and companion Markdown were written.
format_boundary: Inspected actual Free Format + AMA product. This report does not claim the offline-incomplete original NJD template/class was reproduced unchanged.
review_method: Every page-01.png through page-25.png was separately returned by tools.view_image and directly visually inspected. Four-page batches were used. Page 19 was directly re-viewed with detail=original. No contact sheet or text extraction substituted for page inspection.

checks.clipping_or_occlusion: None observed on any of 25 directly viewed pages.
checks.fonts_math: Body text, math, superscripts and symbols readable. Table 2 uses visibly smaller but readable type.
checks.ama_citations: Superscript numeric citations readable. Numbered references [1]-[31] rendered. Punctuation exceptions in E02; no bibliographic fact audit claimed.
checks.after_references_tables: References end on page 17. Tables 1-8 each occupy one independent page on pages 18-25.
checks.numeric_columns: All table numeric columns, signs, percentage signs and NA entries inspected and readable. This is visual verification, not numerical recomputation.
checks.figure_legends_units: Figures 1-6 axes, legends, units and captions inspected; no clipping or unreadable label observed.
checks.wp2_and_s39: Page 7 WP2 history-length extension is one complete paragraph. Supplement Section S39 prints clearly at its end. No supplement-target semantic audit performed in this main-manuscript-only task.

findings.location: Page 1 below title; page 15 Author-provided information block
findings.observed: Page 1 has [AUTHOR INFORMATION TO BE COMPLETED]. Page 15 has [TO BE COMPLETED BY AUTHOR] for author information, ORCID, funding, and competing interests.
findings.recommendation_to_root: Retain the known author-input boundary. These unresolved fields need actual author inputs through the parent workflow; they are not clipping or rendering defects.

findings.location: Reference [4] on page 15; references [18]-[21] and [25] on page 16
findings.observed: [4] ends with Delft University of Technology. : 2017.; [18]-[21] have a space before the period after the institutional author; [21] contains Historical compressed. : . Retrieved October 24, 2026.; [25] contains Walter Vaughn J. ., eds.
findings.recommendation_to_root: Review bibliography-output punctuation without changing scientific numbers or adding unverified bibliographic facts.

overall_explanation: All 25 page images passed clipping, occlusion and legibility inspection. Parent workflow should handle known author completion placeholders and minor bibliography punctuation. This verdict is not final submission authorization and does not erase the author-input boundary.
